title: Anigyesɛm a Ɛfa Mpanyinyɛ Mu
intro: Woredi bere bi a anidaso asan akanyan no ho adanse. Awarefo bi a wɔadi mfe a wɔde bɛyɛ awofo bere tenten no nya bɔhyɛ bi a ɛne abɔde mu mmara nhyia. Wɔn mfinimfini gyina hɔ ma onipa bi a ne ba a waba ankasa yɛ ɔsoro mmɔborohunu ho sɛnkyerɛnne —ɔkra a wɔahyɛ sɛ ɔbɛyɛ nkɔmhyɛ, a okura agyapade a ɛbɛtrɛw awo ntoatoaso ahorow mu. Hena ne onipa a ɔyɛ nwonwa yi?
clues: Awofo a na wɔadu mpanyin afe so na wonni mma na wɔwoo me.
Abɔfo a wɔbaa m’abusua nkyɛn sɛ ahɔho na wɔbɔɔ m’awo ho amanneɛ.
Wɔmaa me nyansa ne nkɔmhyɛ, na wɔka me ho asɛm wɔ ɔyarefo no ho.
Wɔfrɛɛ m’agya sɛ Allah adamfo, na na meyɛ akyɛdeɛ ma no wɔ ne mfeɛ a ɛdi akyire no mu.
Na mewɔ onua bi a ɔno nso yɛ odiyifoɔ, na yɛn Awurade hyiraa yɛn mmienu nyinaa.
Na me babarima nso yɛ odiyifoɔ, na wɔmaa m’asefoɔ kyerɛwsɛm ne nkɔmhyɛni.

trial.label: Sɔhwɛ/Asɛm a esii

Ɔsii adaka de gyee agyidifoɔ nkwa
trial.answer: Wɔwoo no maa awofo a wɔn mfe akɔ anim

options: Ɔbɛyɛɛ odiyifo a ɔwɔ adiyifo abusua

outcome.answer: Ɔbɛyɛɛ odiyifo a ɔwɔ adiyifo abusua

arabic: ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى وَهَبَ لِى عَلَى ٱلْكِبَرِ إِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَإِسْحَـٰقَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّى لَسَمِيعُ ٱلدُّعَآءِ
verse: Praise to Allāh, who has granted to me in old age Ishmael and Isaac. Indeed, my Lord is the Hearer of supplication. (14:39)
